chapter.verse: Tua thute khit ciangin vantungah a om mihonpite’ aw tawh kibang aw ka zak in, “Hallelujah! gupna thu-a kipan vangliatna leh minthan’na in i Pasian tawh kipawl hi.

A thukhenna a man a dik hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, a gilo nu leh pa khialhna tawh leitungmite a siasak nuam numei gilo tungah thu khenin, a sisa a silate’ sisan hangin ama tungah daan a tat zo hi,” ci-in a gen uh hi.
“Hallelujah!” ci-in nih veina a phat kik uh hi. Tua khuapi meikhu in a tawntungin a kahto hi.
Upa sawm nih leh lite tawh ganhing lite in, tokhom tungah tu-a a om Pasian mai-ah bokin bia-in, “Amen, Hallelujah!” a ci uh hi.
Tokhom sung pan a pusuak aw in: “Topa a kihta a neu a lian mi, a silate aw, eite Pasian phat un,” a ci hi.
Tua lai takin mi honpi’ aw, tui lianpi’ aw, nakpi vanging’ aw bang kampau’ aw in: “Hallelujah! Bang hang hiam i cih leh, Vanglianpen Topa i Pasian in a mang hi.
Lungdamin nuam ni, a min phat ni! Bang hang hiam i cih leh, Tuuno’ zipi hun a tung zo hi. A lawmnu in kiging kholsa-in a om hi.
A siangtho, a ngo mahmah saihadial puan silhna thu a ngah hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, tua saihadial puan in misiangthote’ dik gamtatna ahi hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
Tua lai takin vantungmi in, “Tuuno’ zipina pawi-ah a kisam mite thupha ngah ahi uh hi,” ci-in na gelh in ci-in ahi zongin, “Hih kam in Pasian’ thuman thu ahi hi, ci-in ahi zongin a hong gen ciangin,

kei in tua vantungmi’ khe kiangah bokin bia dingin ka kisak leh, amah in, “Kei hong bia kei in! Kei in nang tawh ahi zongin, Zeisu’ teci pan’na a sang na sanggamte tawh ahi zongin sila ka hi khawm hi, Pasian bia in! Bang hang hiam na cih leh, Zeisu’ teci pan’na thu in kamsangte lungsim ahi hi,” ci-in kei kiangah hong gen hi.
Tua khit ciangin vantung kihongin ka et leh, sakol kaang khat ka mu hi. Tua sakol tung tuang mi in Dikna leh Thuman kici hi. Tua mi in dik takin thu a khen thei, gal a do thei hi.
Ama mittangte in meikuang ahi hi. A lu tungah kumpilukhu tampi a om hi. Amah sim loh kuamah in a theih zawh loh min zong a nei hi.
Sisan tawh kitheh puanza a silh hi. Ama min in Pasian’ Thu ahi hi.
Vantunga om galkapte in zong a siangtho a paak saihadial silhin sakol kaang tungah tuangin ama nung a zui uh hi.
Mipawl pawlte sat nading ama kam sungpan namsau a hiam a pusuak hi. Amaute zong sik ciangkhut tawh a uk ding hi. Vanglianpen Pasian’ hehna leenggahzu kicilna phual amah in a cil hi.
Ama puanza tung leh a phei tungah, “kumpite’ Kumpi, topate’ Topa ” ci-in min a kigelh hi.
Tua nung ciangin vantungmi khat in ni sungah ding-in a om ka mu hi. Amah in van kim lai-ah a leeng vasate kiangah, “Pasian’ nitak an nekna lianpi-ah kikhawmin hong pai un.
Kumpite’ sa, galkapte’ sa, a vanglian mite’ sa, sakol leh sakol tung tuang mite’ sa, sila leh to nei lo mi lian, mi neu a om khempeuhte’ sa uh ne dingin hong pai un,” ci-in nakpi-in a kiko hi.
Tua lai takin sahang-a kipan leitung kumpite leh amau galkapte in sakol tungah tuang mi akipan, galkapte tawh kigaldo dingun a kikhawm uh ka muh khit ciangin,

sahang tawh, sahang mai-ah nalamdangte lakin, sahang ciamtehna nei-in, sahang milim a bia uh mite a kheem, a zuau kamsangpa in kimatna a thuak khit ciangin, amau nih in kat meiphual sungah a hing tangin kikhiatna a thuak uh hi.
A om lai mite in sakol tungah a tuang mipa’ kamsung pan a pusuak namsau tawh thahna thuakin, ka gensa vasate in amaute’ sa kham takin a ne uh hi.
